title: linum gallicum subvar. aureum
intro: Linum gallicum subvar. aureum, commonly known as the golden-flowered flax, is a subvariety of the Linum gallicum plant, belonging to the Linaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Linum gallicum subvar. aureum include treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, as well as providing relief from pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
